content.description: Front brake caliper assembly showing measurement location for rotor disc runout

content.text: Measure the rotor disc runout at 10 mm (0.39 in.) from the outer edge of rotor disc.
If the runout is greater than the maximum, replace the disc.
NOTE: Make sure the front bearing is adjusted correctly.

content.description: Front brake rotor disc and hub assembly showing disc removal

items: (a) Remove the torque rod from the knuckle.
(b) Remove the axle hub. (See page FA-6)
(c) Remove the disc from the axle hub.
(d) Install a new rotor disc. Torque four bolts.

content.text: (e) Install the axle hub and adjust the front bearing preload. (See page FA-8)
(f) Install the torque plate onto the knuckle.
